Fully visible card: icon (gray dust bag image), name "Dust Bag", progress bar, lifespan text, and 2 action icons (refresh + play), same pattern as item_card_squeegee_blade.

relationships.notes: gap between successive cards is consistently 39px, matching (within 1-2px) the 38-40px gap measured between cards in SET-01
same 613px card width and internal icon-left/name+progress-middle/actions-right layout pattern as SET-01's cards, confirming this is the same repeating component at a different canvas size
